hook: The pitch DM that gets replies

items.title: Open with their clip
items.say: One. Open with a clip you made from their show.

items.title: Show one result
items.say: Two. Show one result, not your whole life story.

items.title: Make one clear offer
items.say: Three. End with one clear offer they can say yes to.

caption: Steal this pitch 📩 Share it with a clipper hunting clients.
